## 2026-07-12 — Remove passlib and use raw bcrypt directly
**Risk identified:** The `passlib` library has been unmaintained and its underlying `crypt` module dependency was removed in Python 3.13, causing failures when checking password hashes in modern Python environments. It is effectively end-of-life and risky.
**Migration target:** Use the native `bcrypt` library directly. Native `bcrypt` seamlessly handles the `$2b$` format hashes previously generated by `passlib`, ensuring full compatibility going forward.
**Migrated this session:** Replaced `passlib[bcrypt]` with `bcrypt` in `backend/requirements.txt` and refactored `verify_password` and `get_password_hash` in `backend/app/core/security.py` to use `bcrypt` directly.
**Remaining:** No remaining actions for this specific dependency; it has been entirely removed from the backend.
**Next session:** Identify and migrate the next highest-risk dependency or deprecated pattern.
